What it does

One prompt, several models, answers side by side. Useful because model strengths differ by task more than benchmarks suggest, and the fastest way to find out which one suits your work is to ask all of them.

It is also how we pick models for client deployments — and the practice that led to CrossCheck AI, once it became clear how often two good models disagree on the same business question.

Questions people actually ask

Before you call

Why not just subscribe to one?

If one model does everything you need, do that. Ora is for people whose work spans tasks where the best model genuinely changes.
